title: Long-term rates are low now, too
label: Foreign buyers have helped keep long-term
rates low recently, too — as have new rules
encouraging banks to hold government debt and
expectations that economic growth could be
weak for a long time.
The 10-year Treasury yield was as low as it
has ever been in July 2012 and has risen only
modestly since.
Some economists refer to the economic
pessimism as “the new normal.”

title: Lowest: July 2012
label: The 10-year yield averaged 1.53 percent in
July 2012. On July 25 it closed at 1.43
percent.
